blocks.text: Program likhne ke liye computer programming mein yeh basic (bunyadi) steps (qadam) hote hain:

items: Write Code (code likhna): programming language mein instructions ka set banana.
Compile/Interpret (translate karna, yani tarjuma): code ko aisi shakal mein badalna jo computer samajh sake.
Execute (chalana): code chala kar kaam karwana.
Output (nateeja): results screen par dikhana ya code ke mutabiq koi kaam karna.

blocks.prompt: In mein se kaunsa basic programming process (kaam ke tareeqe) ka hissa nahi: code likhna, compile ya interpret, execute, ghaltiyan ignore (nazar-andaz) karna (MCQ 1)?
blocks.explanation: Ghaltiyan ignore karna, option (d); ghaltiyan dhoond kar theek karni hoti hain.

items: Chaar steps: code likhna, compile/interpret, execute, output.
